properties.title: Luxury Home in Four Seasons at Parkland
properties.description: Welcome to luxury living in the highly sought-after Four Seasons at Parkland, an exclusive 55+ active adult community. This stunning Huntsford model offers 3 bedrooms, including a private detached casita—perfect for guests, a home office, or multi-generational living—along with 2.5 bathrooms and an expansive 3,029 square feet under air. This home is richly appointed with high-end designer finishes and thoughtful upgrades throughout. The chef's dream kitchen features premium appliances, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a spacious center island. The master suite offers a tranquil retreat with a luxurious en-suite bathroom featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in closet. Additional highlights include impact windows, a covered patio, and access to world-class community amenities including pools, tennis courts, and a clubhouse.

properties.title: Modern Villa in Palermo Road
properties.description: Exquisite modern villa featuring an open-concept design with soaring ceilings and abundant natural light. This 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence boasts 2,739 square feet of refined living space. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large center island perfect for entertaining. The primary suite includes a spa-like bathroom with a soaking tub and separate shower. Additional features include a private office, impact-resistant windows and doors, and a beautifully landscaped backyard with a covered lanai. Located in the prestigious Parkland Golf & Country Club community, residents enjoy access to championship golf courses, tennis facilities, and a world-class clubhouse.

properties.title: Contemporary Home in Kalmar Circle
properties.description: Stunning contemporary residence offering 2 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms across 2,002 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. This home features an open floor plan with a modern kitchen featuring quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom with dual vanities. Additional highlights include a covered patio, impact windows, and a two-car garage. Situated in the desirable Four Seasons at Parkland community, residents enjoy access to resort-style amenities including pools, fitness center, tennis courts, and a clubhouse with dining options.

properties.title: Elegant Estate in Bastille Circle
properties.description: Magnificent estate home offering 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms across 3,016 square feet of luxurious living space. This residence features an elegant open floor plan with a gourmet kitchen equipped with Wolf appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large island with waterfall edges. The primary suite is a true sanctuary with a spa-inspired bathroom featuring a soaking tub, rain shower, and his-and-her vanities. Additional amenities include a home theater, wine cellar, and a resort-style backyard with a saltwater pool and outdoor kitchen. Located in the exclusive Parkland Golf & Country Club, residents enjoy access to championship golf, tennis, and world-class dining.

properties.title: Luxury Residence in Bastille Circle
properties.description: Exceptional luxury home featuring 3 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms across 3,036 square feet of sophisticated living space. This residence boasts a contemporary design with floor-to-ceiling windows, an open-concept layout, and premium finishes throughout. The chef's kitchen includes Sub-Zero appliances, custom cabinetry, and a massive island perfect for entertaining. The primary suite offers a private retreat with a spa bathroom featuring a steam shower and soaking tub. Additional features include a home office, smart home technology, impact windows, and a beautifully landscaped backyard with a pool and outdoor living area. Located in the prestigious Four Seasons at Parkland community.

properties.title: Charming Home in Vivar Run
properties.description: Delightful 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offering 2,300 square feet of comfortable living space. This residence features an open floor plan with a modern kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast nook. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom. Additional highlights include a covered patio, impact windows, and a two-car garage. The backyard is perfect for outdoor entertaining with plenty of space for a pool. Located in the family-friendly Four Seasons at Parkland community with access to pools, tennis courts, and a clubhouse.

properties.title: Modern Apartment in Downtown Miami
properties.description: Stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in the heart of Brickell. This 1,200 square foot residence features floor-to-ceiling windows with breathtaking city and bay views. The modern kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and custom cabinetry. The building offers world-class amenities including a rooftop pool, fitness center, 24-hour concierge, and valet parking. Walking distance to restaurants, shops, and public transportation. Perfect for professionals seeking luxury urban living.

properties.title: Beachfront Condo in South Beach
properties.description: Spectacular 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom beachfront condo with direct ocean views. This 1,200 square foot residence features an open floor plan with a gourmet kitchen, impact windows, and a private balcony. The building offers resort-style amenities including beach access, pool, fitness center, and 24-hour security. Steps away from world-class dining, shopping, and nightlife on Ocean Drive. Perfect for those seeking the ultimate Miami Beach lifestyle.

properties.title: Luxury Penthouse in Brickell
properties.description: Extraordinary penthouse residence offering 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms across 1,500 square feet of luxury living. This stunning home features 12-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of Biscayne Bay and the Miami skyline. The gourmet kitchen includes Wolf appliances, custom cabinetry, and a wine cooler. The primary suite features a spa bathroom with a soaking tub and rain shower. Building amenities include rooftop pool, private elevator access, 24-hour concierge, and valet parking. The epitome of Miami luxury living.

properties.title: Investment Property in Wynwood
properties.description: Excellent investment opportunity in the heart of Wynwood. This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom property offers 2,000 square feet across two units, perfect for rental income or live-in with rental. The property has been recently renovated with modern kitchens, updated bathrooms, and new flooring. Located steps away from Wynwood Walls, galleries, restaurants, and the vibrant arts district. Strong rental demand with potential for high ROI. Ideal for investors looking to capitalize on Miami's booming real estate market.

properties.title: Commercial Space in Design District
properties.description: Prime commercial space in Miami's prestigious Design District. This 3,000 square foot suite features an open floor plan with high ceilings, modern finishes, and abundant natural light. Perfect for retail, gallery, or office use. The building offers 24-hour security, parking, and is surrounded by luxury boutiques, restaurants, and art galleries. Excellent visibility and foot traffic in one of Miami's most sought-after locations. Strong investment potential with high appreciation expected.

properties.title: Development Opportunity in Little Havana
properties.description: Excellent development opportunity in the vibrant Little Havana neighborhood. This 6,534 square foot lot is zoned for multi-family development with potential for up to 12 units. Located steps away from Calle Ocho, restaurants, galleries, and cultural attractions. The area is experiencing rapid gentrification with increasing property values. Perfect for developers looking to build apartments, condos, or mixed-use projects. Strong rental demand and proximity to downtown Miami make this an ideal investment.

properties.title: Spacious Family Home in Coral Springs
properties.description: Beautiful 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom family home offering 2,500 square feet of comfortable living space. This residence features an open floor plan with a modern kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom with dual vanities. Additional highlights include a covered patio, impact windows, and a two-car garage. The backyard is perfect for outdoor activities with plenty of space for a pool. Located in a family-friendly neighborhood with excellent schools and parks nearby.

properties.title: Modern Condo in Edgewater
properties.description: Stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in Miami's trendy Edgewater neighborhood. This 1,200 square foot residence features floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of Biscayne Bay and the Miami skyline. The modern kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and custom cabinetry. Building amenities include a rooftop pool, fitness center, 24-hour concierge, and valet parking. Walking distance to the Design District, Wynwood, and Midtown. Perfect for professionals seeking luxury urban living with bay views.

properties.title: Waterfront Estate in Fort Lauderdale
properties.description: Spectacular waterfront estate offering 5 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms across 4,000 square feet of luxury living. This residence features direct ocean access with a private dock, infinity pool, and outdoor kitchen. The gourmet kitchen includes Wolf appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large island. The primary suite is a sanctuary with a spa bathroom featuring a soaking tub, rain shower, and his-and-her vanities. Additional amenities include a home theater, wine cellar, and smart home technology throughout. Located in the exclusive Harbor Beach neighborhood with private beach access.

properties.title: Cozy Studio in South Beach
properties.description: Charming studio apartment in the heart of South Beach. This 600 square foot residence features an open layout with modern kitchen, full bathroom, and large windows. The building offers a pool, fitness center, and 24-hour security. Steps away from the beach, restaurants, shops, and nightlife on Collins Avenue. Perfect for young professionals or students seeking the vibrant South Beach lifestyle at an affordable price.

properties.title: Investment Duplex in Little Haiti
properties.description: Excellent investment opportunity in the up-and-coming Little Haiti neighborhood. This duplex offers 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms across 2,000 square feet with two separate units. Each unit features 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, kitchen, and living area. The property has been recently updated with new roofs, electrical, and plumbing. Located near the Design District, Wynwood, and downtown Miami. Strong rental demand with potential for appreciation as the neighborhood continues to gentrify. Perfect for investors seeking cash flow and long-term growth.

properties.title: Luxury Townhome in Coconut Grove
properties.description: Elegant 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom townhome in the prestigious Coconut Grove neighborhood. This 3,000 square foot residence features an open floor plan with high ceilings, gourmet kitchen with premium appliances, and a private rooftop terrace with stunning bay views. The primary suite includes a spa bathroom and walk-in closet. Additional features include a two-car garage, impact windows, and smart home technology. Walking distance to CocoWalk, restaurants, and marinas. Perfect for those seeking luxury living in a vibrant, tree-lined community.

properties.title: Family Apartment in Brickell
properties.description: Spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in the heart of Brickell. This 1,200 square foot residence features an open floor plan with modern kitchen, stainless steel appliances, and city views. The building offers resort-style amenities including a pool, fitness center, spa, and 24-hour concierge. Walking distance to Brickell City Centre, restaurants, and public transportation. Perfect for families or professionals seeking luxury urban living in Miami's financial district.

properties.title: Mixed-Use Building in Allapattah
properties.description: Prime mixed-use investment opportunity in the rapidly developing Allapattah neighborhood. This 3,000 square foot building features a ground-floor retail space with 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residential unit above. Recently renovated with modern finishes, new HVAC, and updated electrical. Located near Wynwood, the Design District, and Jackson Memorial Hospital. Strong rental demand with potential for both retail and residential income. Perfect for investors seeking diversified income streams in an emerging market.

properties.title: Golf Course Villa in Weston
properties.description: Magnificent 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom villa overlooking the golf course in Weston's prestigious Bonaventure community. This 3,000 square foot residence features an open floor plan with a gourmet kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a center island. The primary suite offers a private retreat with a spa bathroom and walk-in closet. Additional highlights include a covered patio, impact windows, and a two-car garage. The backyard offers stunning golf course views and plenty of space for outdoor entertaining. Residents enjoy access to championship golf courses, tennis courts, pools, and a clubhouse.
